experience.context: IT outsourcing company — client project: multi-brand consumer web platform, 30+ locales (under NDA).
experience.team: 7 engineers (frontend and backend), designers, product owners
achievements: Shipped features and fixes across an Astro/TypeScript monorepo and its Spring Boot backend, e.g. fixed framed QR codes that rendered broken in Safari and in PNG/JPEG exports by embedding the code as a nested SVG instead of a foreignObject.

Built custom highlight colors for CMS-edited rich text end to end: Spring Boot validation, server-side rendering that allows only strict hex values into inline styles, and rules for the LLM translator.
Moved the shared client JavaScript (15 modules, ~4.6k lines) out of the Spring Boot app into a frontend package, then deleted the backend copy after checking CDN analytics.

Launched 8 A/B and painted-door tests on landing pages, funnels and paywalls with the in-house experiment framework, keeping the control arm byte-identical, and cleaned up 9 finished experiments by removing the losing variant and its wiring.
Redesigned the flagship site's footer with a language picker for its 32 locales and added the picker to the shared footer used by four other brand sites.

Added a build-time check that fails when a site's locales, translation bundles and language names disagree, and fixed a production error found through Sentry, where quotes in translations broke Alpine.js expressions.

experience.context: Websites built to order — VM Design (interior architecture studio): vmdesignproject.com; Grosters: grosters.com

achievements.text: built a multilingual Astro static site — 22 projects, 5 locales, ~190 pages from typed Markdown collections — with an image pipeline producing ~5,000 AVIF/WebP variants; Lighthouse 100 in all four categories on mobile and desktop (LCP 1.7 s / 0.4 s, CLS 0).

achievements.label: VM Design
achievements.text: wrote interactive components in vanilla TypeScript (before/after slider, carousel, native-dialog lightbox, WebGL gallery); dropping a React wrapper cut gallery JS from 289 KB to 65 KB (a 77% reduction).

achievements.label: VM Design
achievements.text: generated custom SVG regional maps from GeoJSON (no map library) and built a Python pipeline to redact client PDFs before publication.

achievements.label: VM Design
achievements.text: handled the production setup end-to-end: domain, DNS and Cloudflare configuration, with the site deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

achievements.label: Grosters (grosters.com)
achievements.text: shipped a 4-page mobile-first commercial site solo, from requirements to production; optimized images and loading — Lighthouse 99 Performance / 100 Best Practices / 91 Accessibility (LCP 0.8 s, CLS 0).

achievements: Delivered 30+ merged PRs (bug fixes, QA tickets, Figma-based UI) in a monorepo serving three brands and four licensed markets: UK, Spain, Cyprus, Sweden.
Built fixes and features for the Swedish market launch, my largest area of work: localization, currency and number formatting, regulator-specific content, restricted-content removal.
Fixed a translation-loading race condition that showed raw i18n keys on 92% of cold page loads; it no longer reproduces.
Consolidated the design system (25 font sizes down to an 11-step scale, shared button variants) and improved accessibility and mobile UX: touch targets, alt text, iOS fixes.

experience.context: Multi-module CRM platform for business clients (pre-release).
achievements: Cut the main production bundle from 685 KB to 341 KB gzipped by converting 35 page routes to React.lazy + Suspense code splitting.
Restructured a 149-component codebase into a domain-based architecture, reducing root-level files from ~120 to 21.
Migrated hard-coded strings to i18next (EN/UK) and added a CI check that fails builds on non-localized strings.
Fixed 30+ production defects across Deals, Properties and Profile, and enforced react-hooks/exhaustive-deps as an error to block a recurring bug class.

experience.context: Patient data de-identification platform for healthcare providers (under NDA)
achievements: Implemented passwordless magic-link authentication end-to-end (React + Nest.js), with link expiry and automatic session termination after 2h of inactivity.
Built the 4-step patient data de-identification flow and the main dashboard from Figma designs, responsive across desktop and tablet.
Iterated on auth, sidebar and email templates over two client demo cycles.
